packageRules.description: Routine bumps: every non-major update in one weekly PR.
A 0.x minor bump (0.4 -> 0.5) is breaking in Cargo, so it gets its own PR.

Lockstep Set (see GLOSSARY.md): this list is the single source of truth. Only reported on the Dependency Dashboard; upgraded as a whole by /upgrade-lockstep-set. The [patch.crates-io] openthread crates belong to it too, but Renovate never reads patch tables.
